the elucidation of the mechanism of action of the regulatory-site peptide of the biodegradative enzyme threonine deaminase of Eschericia coli.
the mechanism of action of threonine deaminase and the regulation of its activity.
the elucidation of a mechanism for the control of enzyme activity by covalent protein-modification in E. coli.
